नागनाथ patron of Lakṣmīdāsa (Gaṇitatattvacintāmaṇi).
Cambr. 52.

नागनाथ son of Nīlakaṇṭha, son of Viṣṇu, son of Nī-
lakaṇṭha, son of Rāma. He was father of Nṛsiṃha,
father of Nāganātha, father of Jñānarāja (Siddhānta-
sundara), father of Sūryadāsa. The second Nāga-
nātha seems to be the author of:
 Parvaprabodha jy. B. 4, 152.

नागनाथ son of Kṛṣṇa Paṇḍita, guru of Lakṣmaṇa
(Yogacandrikā):
 Nidānapradīpa on Mādhavakara's Nidāna. IO. 347.
Bik. 652.

नागनाथ son of Nimbadeva, brother of Lakṣmīdhara,
grandson of Kamaladeva of Candrapura:
 Padāmnāyasiddhi, a C. on Lakṣmīdhara's Gali-
tapradīpa. Hall p. 134.

नागनाथ son of Mudgala, father of Narasiṃha (Khaṇḍa-
praśasta).
[]

नागनाथ son of Kṛṣṇapaṇḍita:
 Nidānapradīpa, which seems to be an independant
work.

ṭīkā 1681). IO. 55 A.
